name: Symbiotic Being

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Something lives in you: a skill, a language and Hit Point Dice to shore up failed saves; on a natural 1 it may take the reins.

benefits.name: Symbiote's Knowledge
benefits.summary: Proficiency in one skill and one extra language.
benefits.text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and learn one language of your choice.

benefits.name: Symbiote's Vigor
benefits.summary: When you fail a save, spend a Hit Point Die and add its roll (PB times per Long Rest).
benefits.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can spend one of your Hit Point Dice, roll it and add the number rolled to the save, possibly turning it into a success. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: On a natural 1: Wisdom save (DC 13 + PB) or Charmed by the symbiote for 1d12 hours, which steers you; taking damage lets you repeat the save.
drawback.text: Whenever you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure the symbiote seizes you: you have the Charmed condition for 1d12 hours and it directs what you do (in a fight you only Dodge, keeping its host alive). Whenever you take damage you can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.
